Subject: New vendor onboarding: invoice submission options & template

Hi Jonas / Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Finance at Starlabs is ready to start sending invoices but we have a couple of questions before we go live:

1) Which intake channel do you prefer for new vendors — portal submission or email to accounts-payable? Our AP team can do either but portal submission requires us to map to your subject-token/PO headers.

2) If we email invoices, what subject lines and attachment naming conventions will allow auto-ingest (subject token, PO number, vendor id)?

3) We usually send one PDF per invoice but sometimes group multi-PO lines into a single PDF. Does Redwood support multi-PO PDFs or do you prefer separate invoices/rows?

I attached an example invoice PDF and a CSV export of our usual line format for reference.

Appreciate a short checklist so we can align our team.

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the examples. High level: we prefer portal-first for production vendors because it gives better idempotency and PO linking, but email is an acceptable fallback during onboarding or for small-volume suppliers. Below is a concise checklist and the subject/attachment conventions our ingest expects if you choose email fallback.

Portal (preferred):
- Complete vendor onboarding form (link below).
- Submit invoices via the portal; each upload maps to a single invoice record and supports multi-line PO attachments.
- Portal automatically validates PO numbers and returns an ACK token.

Email fallback (if portal unavailable):
- Send to accounts-payable@redwood.ai with the SUBJECT prefixed by: [VENDOR=STARB-<vendor-id>] [PO=<po-number>] e.g. "[VENDOR=STARB-1234] [PO=PO-98765] Invoice 202603-01".
- Attachment: single PDF per invoice recommended. For multi-PO invoices, include a CSV (sample attached) with one line per PO-line so our ingest can split and map automatically.
- Filename convention: vendorid_invoice_YYYYMMDD_PO.pdf (e.g. STARB-1234_invoice_20260310_PO98765.pdf).

PO stamping & multi-PO guidance:
- We accept a PDF that contains multiple PO sections, but for reliable automated processing include a CSV that enumerates each line with PO, line amount, tax, and description. Our parser will use the CSV as the source-of-truth for PO mapping.

Next steps:
1) Please complete the onboarding form here: https://redwood.app/onboarding/vendor-form (we'll provision your portal account within 24 business hours).
2) While your portal account is provisioned, continue to email invoices with the subject and filename conventions above.

I'm attaching our vendor onboarding form and a small sample CSV that mirrors the fields our ingest wants. If you prefer, Monica can run a short test ingest with a single invoice to confirm mapping.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — good questions. Short answers: yes, and <= 24 hours for most portal ACKs (48 hours worst case during high volume). Details below.

1) PO formatting: our parser normalizes PO strings to digits-only before matching. So "PO-98765", "98765" and "98765 " will all match. To minimize false positives, please include the PO in the CSV PO column and ideally mirror the same PO in the PDF header.

2) ACK SLA: portal ACKs are typically issued within 1 business hour; we guarantee ACK or rejection within 24 business hours for onboarding accounts. If you use the email fallback, our ingest system will reply with an ACK email within 24–48 hours (shorter during normal volume).

Test run: can you send one test invoice (PDF + CSV) to accounts-payable@redwood.ai using the subject format below? Monica will pick up the ingestion results and confirm mapping.

Subject template to use for test: [VENDOR=STARB-1234] [PO=98765] Invoice test 202603
Filename: STARB-1234_invoice_20260311_PO98765.pdf
CSV columns we expect (sample_invoice_rows.csv attached): vendor_id, invoice_date, invoice_number, po_number, line_number, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, line_description, currency

I'll escalate if the test shows any mapping issues. Monica will follow up to schedule a 15-min run-through if you prefer live observation.

Thanks,
Jonas
